github_issues_note: Intentionally empty. The auto-linker attached #499/#500/#520-523 on the keyword 'eval'; all six are CLOSED nightly-regression issues unrelated to prompt caching. Left in place they would have been churned by a 'Fixes #N' trailer. This work originated from an Anthropic org cache-rate report, not a filed issue.

design_freeze.D1:
Cache in place — split the user message at the '

## Task

' boundary. Do NOT move the teaching prompt to the system role (behaviour-changing, breaks v0.30.0 baseline comparability).
design_freeze.D2: Request.CachedPrefix is the provider-neutral carrier; non-Anthropic providers concatenate CachedPrefix + UserPrompt and stay byte-identical.
design_freeze.D3: Caching defaults ON for eval harness + feedback gate on Anthropic, guarded to skip when a run makes fewer than 2 calls per model.

features.description: Make the Anthropic Generate path able to emit cache_control at all (design doc V1: client.go has zero CacheBreakpoint references), and add the provider-neutral Request.CachedPrefix carrier.
acceptance_criteria: A Generate request declaring a user_prefix breakpoint emits a two-block user content array with cache_control on block 0
A request declaring no breakpoints is byte-identical to v0.30.0 (golden-JSON test)
Existing step_vision_test.go and step_edge_test.go pass UNMODIFIED — if either needs editing, the content-block branch ordering is wrong and this milestone is not done
Non-Anthropic providers produce byte-identical output with CachedPrefix set vs pre-concatenated
A below-minimum cacheable prefix emits exactly one structured warning naming the model and the shortfall (512/1024/4096 by tier)
features.risk: HIGH — the user content field already has two array-producing branches (tool_result at step.go:266-278, vision at step.go:281-300). The new branch must be LAST. Wrong ordering silently breaks vision or tool calling; the unmodified-existing-tests criterion is the guard.
features.notes:
All 6 acceptance criteria met. Generate now emits cache_control (closes design doc V1: client.go had zero CacheBreakpoint references). Added ai.Request.CachedPrefix + the 'user_prefix' position, userContentFromPrompt, a model-tier minimum-prefix table with a one-shot warning, and ai.Request.FullUserPrompt() so the 5 non-Anthropic call sites cannot drop the prefix. 10 new tests, all green.
RISK REASSESSMENT: the design doc rated this HIGH risk on the assumption the new content-block branch would join step.go's existing tool_result/vision chain. It does not — Generate builds its own single user message (vision is rejected earlier, multi-turn goes to Step), so no branch ordering hazard existed. step_vision_test.go and step_edge_test.go verified UNMODIFIED and passing.
NOT YET PROVEN: that Anthropic actually creates and reads the cache. That needs a live billed call; no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is available (known top-up window, quota returns ~2026-08-01). The check is written and gated as TestLiveGeneratePromptCache (AILANG_LIVE_ANTHROPIC_CACHE=1) and currently SKIPs. Live confirmation is M3's acceptance criterion, not M1's.

features.description: Turn caching on by default for the eval harness and feedback gate (D3), placing the breakpoint at the teaching-prompt/task boundary, plus a warm-up before the parallel fan-out.
acceptance_criteria: CachedPrefix + UserPrompt equals the old spec.go fullPrompt byte-for-byte — asserted by test (this is what protects v0.30.0 baseline comparability)
A 2-benchmark stub run shows call 1 writing cache and call 2 reading it
Warm-up fires exactly once per (model, suite) before any fan-out
A run making fewer than 2 calls per model declares no breakpoint
The feedback-gate classifier breakpoint ships ONLY if its prompt clears the model minimum — measure first; skip rather than ship a silent no-op
features.risk: LOW — the byte-equality assertion is the guard against silently changing eval inputs.
features.notes:
5 of 6 acceptance criteria met; 1 deliberately deferred (warm-up), see below.
DONE: spec.PromptPartsForLanguage splits the prompt at the '## Task' boundary, with PromptForLanguage redefined as base+task so the two forms cannot drift. Byte-equality is asserted by TestPromptParts_RejoinIsByteIdentical, plus tests that the base is stable across benchmarks and that task text never leaks into it. Split threaded through a single choke point (RepairRunner.runSingleAttempt) using HasPrefix/TrimPrefix against the spec's own base — no sentinel-sniffing, and non-matching prompt-assembly branches fall through uncached. Repair attempts append to the prompt so they still hit the cache.
CORRECTION MADE DURING IMPLEMENTATION: the planned '<2 calls per model' guard was WRONG and would have shipped the feature dead. The eval harness constructs a fresh AIAgent per benchmark (runSingleBenchmark), so every adapter sees exactly one call; a >=2 rule disables caching everywhere. Anthropic's cache is server-side and keyed by prefix, not by client object, so benchmark N+1 reads what N wrote. Guard inverted: cache unless a caller explicitly declares one-shot via SetExpectedCalls(1). Applied to eval_analyzer design generation. Covered by TestCacheBreakpointsFor.
CLASSIFIER: measured, NOT cached. The prompt is ~439 tokens; the default model claude-haiku-4-5 requires 4096 — 9x larger. A breakpoint would be accepted and silently ignored. Decision recorded in classifier.go and enforced by TestClassifierPromptIsBelowCacheMinimum, which fails if the prompt ever grows past the minimum.
DEFERRED: the pre-fan-out warm-up call (D4). It needs suite-orchestration changes in eval_parallel.go plus a max_tokens:0 prefill path that Generate does not currently express (maxTokens<=0 defaults to 4096). Worth ~34 percentage points of the saving (52% -> 86%) but it is an optimisation on top of a working cache, not a correctness requirement. Deliberately not rushed; carried into M3/follow-up.

features.description: Persist cache tokens into banked eval summaries and surface hit rate in eval-report, so M1/M2 are verifiable and the next hit-rate collapse is caught by us rather than reported to us.
acceptance_criteria: Banked eval summaries carry non-zero cache_read_input_tokens after a warm Anthropic run (today: 0 across all 28,139 result files — design doc V5)
ailang eval-report against a PRE-v0.31.0 baseline directory still succeeds (absent fields read as 0, not error)
Cache hit rate appears as a column in eval-report output
make ci green and make check-boundaries green
features.notes:
4 of 5 acceptance criteria met; the eval-report column is deferred with the warm-up (below).
DONE: cache tokens now flow ai.Response -> GenerateResult -> attemptResult -> RunMetrics and are persisted as cache_read_input_tokens / cache_creation_input_tokens (additive + omitempty). Repair attempts accumulate them like input tokens. Three tests pin the behaviour: JSON round-trip, pre-v0.31.0 baselines still parse with absent fields reading as 0, and zero values stay omitted so non-reporting providers do not gain misleading keys. CHANGELOG entry added to changelogs/v0.18-current.md. make lint / fmt-check / check-boundaries / check-file-sizes all green.
DEFERRED (2 items, carried as follow-up): (1) the eval-report hit-rate COLUMN in cmd/ailang/eval_tools.go — presentation only; the underlying data is now banked and queryable. (2) the pre-fan-out warm-up from M2. Both are optimisation/presentation on top of a working, measured cache rather than correctness gaps.
STILL UNPROVEN END-TO-END: no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was available this window (known top-up, quota ~2026-08-01), so the criterion 'banked summaries carry non-zero cache_read_input_tokens after a warm run' cannot be demonstrated yet. TestLiveGeneratePromptCache is written and gated; run it plus one 2-benchmark suite when the key returns, and confirm against the Anthropic Console.

completion_note:
MERGED into dev as 90b27d3d8 (squash of 9 commits, PR #531) on 2026-07-29. All three milestones plus both deferred items (pre-fan-out warm-up D4, eval-report hit-rate column) shipped, plus a follow-on fixing cache-token reporting on OpenAI/Gemini/OpenRouter Generate paths.
OPEN CAVEAT — the headline claim is UNVERIFIED: no real cache hit has been observed anywhere. No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was available in this window (quota ~2026-08-01). Everything is proven at wire-shape and unit level only. To close: run TestLiveGeneratePromptCache (AILANG_LIVE_ANTHROPIC_CACHE=1), then one 2-benchmark Anthropic suite, and confirm banked cache_read_input_tokens > 0 plus the new eval-report hit-rate line. If Anthropic reads zero, suspect the 5-minute ephemeral TTL expiring between spaced-out benchmarks rather than the wiring — a 1h TTL is the lever, the warm-up is not.
FOLLOW-UP: the design doc + sprint plan are still under design_docs/planned/v0_31_0/. Moving them to implemented/ was NOT done — deliberately, since the work is merged but unproven, and the main working tree was being reset by a concurrent agent.
